snap.title: OkNetwork
snap.summary: Job alerts for remote and tech jobs that match your skills
snap.description:
OkNetwork (knet) is a job search assistant for your desktop. It watches job boards, company career pages and RSS feeds, and sends you a notification when a new job posting matches your skills, experience and location: no more refreshing job sites.

- Job alerts for remote jobs, tech jobs and developer jobs (software engineer, frontend, backend, full-stack, data, DevOps and more)
- Match score for every job, with the reasons: tech stack, role, seniority, soft skills and where you can work from
- Sources: Remotive, Remote OK, Arbeitnow, Jobicy, Get on Board, and company careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy, BambooHR and Workday, plus any RSS feed
- Job application tracker: applied, screening, interview, offer, with private notes
- Employers and recruiters can post a job for free; matching candidates get notified
- Private by design: your profile stays on your computer. No account, no ads, no tracking

Five themes, including dark mode, Dracula and Pride.
